scope: Android 15 API 35 x86_64 emulator, 1280 by 800, ANGLE with SwiftShader. Normal exported application, campaign menus and touch input; no test-only gameplay or injected session state.

checks.solo: Move Rowan to (4,2), Wait, force-stop, relaunch and reopen the same campaign; exact snapshot and accepted commands preserved.
checks.same_device_coop: Wait with Akari in the second army, force-stop, relaunch and reopen co-op; exact eight-unit snapshot and accepted command preserved.
checks.mode_isolation: Co-op never overwrites the saved solo actions or snapshot.
checks.compatible_app_update: Install the final APK over the first recovery build without clearing application data; recover the same solo state.
checks.presentation: Portuguese language and restored stage title remain; completed opening dialogue and camera pan do not repeat.

apk.signing_note: Final APK re-signed with the first emulator build debug key solely for an in-place update check. Every non-signature ZIP entry is byte-identical to the original.

limitations: No physical Android device was used. Accented Android file-picker names and OEM lifecycle behavior remain to check.
Software-emulated graphics are used for functional checks, not device FPS claims. Direct SwiftShader GLES failed to link Godot canvas shaders; ANGLE with SwiftShader renders normally.
Desktop forced-process checks separately cover combat and enemy turns, damaged recovery files, interrupted replacements and compatible campaign package updates.

release_branch_retest.scope: Android 15 x86_64 emulator with touch at 1280×720. Same development signer on both APKs.
release_branch_retest.results: Open 1P, move Rowan to (2,2), Wait and end the turn. Force-stop, install the current APK in place, reopen the same campaign, and compare the exact round, activation count and unit records. In a separate fresh 2P launch the board has all eight units.
